verdicts.flaw_description: A site-wide discount cutting prices by a fifth ran through every segment's measurement month, and every segment browsed the general catalogue, so the discount covered them all; a 20 percent price cut easily explains the 4-7 percent purchase lift without the new checkout page.

Two of the four cases have their outcome measured before treatment began: group One 'started 4 March' but is scored 'by 28 February', and group Three 'started 5 September' but is scored 'by 30 August', so the reported drop in attacks predates the inhaler.

Corticosteroid injections tripled from the earlier quarter at each hospital and 'every intake was cleared to receive them', so steroid injection — which itself increases shoulder abduction in rotator cuff cases — fits all four gains of 9-16 degrees just as well as the protocol.

The claim is about board defects but the measured quantity is 'mean void area' (down 4-7 percent), a solder-geometry measure, not a defect rate; the runs were actually 'graded at electrical test' and no defect counts from that grading are reported.
